items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: We had John R. Davis, the drummer.

ctx.x: Claude-- what was Claude's last name? Claude Smith? Claude-- oh, could this guy play the violin! And we featured the violin back in those days, also, and we had Booker Pittman. We had John R. Davis, the drummer. Most of these guys were the original guys from when I went to school with, because they were all proficient by this time. And --
So now you're up there at Saint Joseph, Missouri. When did you get into Kansas City?
